biggest_catch: Tasks are location-dependent and approval-gated — rural users see far fewer tasks, and pay varies per task with a 3% PayPal withdrawal fee under £25.
catches: Task availability depends heavily on your city/metro; rural users see few tasks.
Each withdrawal to PayPal carries a 3% fee unless cashing out over £25 via bank transfer (third-party reports; official page confirms PayPal-only in some flows and 48-hour payment window).
Some Roamler programs require an invite code or onboarding test before paid tasks unlock.
Payment only after the Review Team accepts your submission; rejections earn nothing.

steps: Download the free Roamler app, register and complete onboarding.
Browse the map/list of tasks near you; each shows its fixed payment before you accept.
Book and complete the task at the location, submitting photos/answers in-app.
The Review Team validates your submission.
Payment goes to your PayPal account within 48 hours of acceptance.
timing: Paid via PayPal within 48 hours after the Review Team accepts your task.
who_pays: Roamler pays you a fixed rate per completed task — you see exactly what each task pays in the app before you accept it.
who_qualifies: A smartphone with location on and a PayPal account. Tasks are shown based on your location (UK/EU and other markets); some programs need an invite code or onboarding test.
work_available: Heavily metro-dependent — cities see regular tasks, rural users see few. Some programs are invite-only.
what_gets_accepted: The Review Team must accept your submitted task; rejected tasks earn nothing. You see the fixed payment in the app before accepting, so there are no surprises on the rate.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: rejected tasks, onboarding tests for some programs, and travel to task locations. PayPal withdrawals under £25 carry a 3% fee (bank transfer over £25 avoids it — the fee detail is third-party reported; Roamler confirms the 48-hour PayPal window).
when_cash_arrives: Paid via PayPal within 48 hours after the Review Team accepts your task.

repeatable.cadence: New tasks post in your area — complete a task, pass review, get paid via PayPal within 48 hours, and claim the next one.

reject_reason: offline/in-person — catalog is online-only per owner 2026-09-23
